composition_order.proof: Reverse of the flattened concatenated sequence is exactly the reversed eta sequence followed by reversed gamma with the shared endpoint identified once.

count_invariance.proof: Reversal changes order/orientation of the same n consecutive transition occurrences, not their number.

involution.proof: Finite sequence reversal twice restores every indexed packet occurrence.

not_cancellative_inverse.label: REVERSAL_IS_NOT_CANCELLATIVE_INVERSE
not_cancellative_inverse.reason: gamma*rev(gamma) retains both forward-history and reversed-history transition events.
